# Claude Code Resources / Claude Code 资源目录

[English](#english) | [中文](#中文)

A comprehensive catalog of Claude Code capabilities — MCP servers, plugins, and skills — available in the Claude Code ecosystem, with bilingual descriptions.

Claude Code 能力全景目录 — 涵盖 MCP 服务器、插件 (Plugins) 与技能 (Skills) 三大体系，中英双语对照。

---

## English

### What is this repository?

This is a curated catalog of all Claude Code capabilities discovered in a real Claude Code environment (Windows 11 + DeepSeek V4 Pro). It documents **MCP servers**, **plugins**, and **skills** that extend Claude Code's abilities — from code review and PR workflows to design thinking frameworks and GSAP animation tooling.

### File structure

```
.
├── README.md                        # This file (bilingual overview)
└── CLAUDE-CODE-能力目录.md           # Full Chinese catalog of all capabilities
```

The single catalog file (`CLAUDE-CODE-能力目录.md`) contains detailed tables for every MCP server, plugin, and skill, organized by category.

### Quick summary

| Category | Count | Description |
|----------|-------|-------------|
| **MCP Servers** | 3 | External services via Model Context Protocol (pencil, ide, playwright) |
| **Plugins (enabled)** | 33 | Active plugins spanning dev tools, output styles, LSPs, and integrations |
| **LSP Plugins** | 12 | Language servers (Python, Rust, Go, TypeScript, C++, etc.) |
| **Skills** | 65+ | Categorized into 10 groups (dev workflow, decision frameworks, design, etc.) |

### Usage

Open [`CLAUDE-CODE-能力目录.md`](./CLAUDE-CODE-%E8%83%BD%E5%8A%9B%E7%9B%AE%E5%BD%95.md) to browse the full catalog:

- **MCP Servers** — pencil (design editor), ide (VS Code integration), playwright (browser automation)
- **Plugins** — feature-dev, code-review, commit-commands, hookify, plugin-dev, skill-creator, agent-sdk-dev, and more
- **Skills** — 10 categories including dev workflows, decision frameworks (Cynefin, Eisenhower, RICE, SWOT, etc.), GSAP animations, document processing (PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX), design & creativity, self-improvement agents, and integrations (Stripe, Discord, Telegram)

### Keywords

`claude-code` `skills` `mcp` `plugins` `catalog` `capabilities` `中文` `bilingual`

---

## 中文

### 这是什么仓库？

这是一个在真实 Claude Code 环境（Windows 11 + DeepSeek V4 Pro）中整理的能力全景目录。记录了扩展 Claude Code 能力的全部 **MCP 服务器**、**插件** 和 **技能** — 涵盖从代码审查、PR 工作流到设计思维框架、GSAP 动画工具的方方面面。

### 文件结构

```
.
├── README.md                        # 本文件（双语概览）
└── CLAUDE-CODE-能力目录.md           # 完整中文能力目录
```

唯一的目录文件 (`CLAUDE-CODE-能力目录.md`) 包含每个 MCP 服务器、插件和技能的详细表格，按类别组织。

### 快速概览

| 类别 | 数量 | 说明 |
|------|------|------|
| **MCP 服务器** | 3 个 | 通过 Model Context Protocol 连接的外部服务（pencil、ide、playwright） |
| **启用插件** | 33 个 | 涵盖开发工具、输出风格、LSP、第三方集成 |
| **LSP 插件** | 12 个 | 语言服务器（Python、Rust、Go、TypeScript、C++ 等） |
| **Skills 技能** | 65+ | 分为 10 大类（开发流程、决策框架、设计创意等） |

### 使用方式

打开 [`CLAUDE-CODE-能力目录.md`](./CLAUDE-CODE-%E8%83%BD%E5%8A%9B%E7%9B%AE%E5%BD%95.md) 浏览完整目录：

- **MCP 服务器** — pencil（设计编辑器）、ide（VS Code 集成）、playwright（浏览器自动化）
- **插件** — feature-dev、code-review、commit-commands、hookify、plugin-dev、skill-creator、agent-sdk-dev 等
- **技能** — 10 大类别：开发流程、决策框架（Cynefin、艾森豪威尔、RICE、SWOT 等）、GSAP 动画、文档处理（PDF/DOCX/PPTX/XLSX）、设计与创意、自我改进代理、集成（Stripe、Discord、Telegram）

### 关键词

`claude-code` `skills` `mcp` `plugins` `catalog` `capabilities` `中文` `bilingual`
